name: Cold Brew Mocha Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 180 mg per can, printed on the front
summary: Cold brew mocha built on oatmilk rather than dairy, at a label-printed 180 mg of caffeine per 11 fl oz can and 150 calories. All 16 g of its sugar is added, and the ingredient list runs to cane sugar, cocoa powder and olive oil — an unusual fat for a canned latte — for 2 g of protein and 7 g of fat. Great Lakes cans a Lavender Latte on the same base, and names a Vanilla in their variety pack that has no page of its own.
